# Catalogue authority (portable build)

> This file replaces the `hirehospo-products` skill for installs that don't have it. It carries the
> category-level truth needed to write catalogue-accurate creative. It does **not** carry the
> per-product export (`active-products.csv`, 241 active products with SKU, price, and URL) - so
> **specific product names, exact prices, and product URLs must be looked up on
> `hirehospo.com` and supplied in the request**, or written as a placeholder plus
> `⚠ confirm before publishing`.
>
> **If `hirehospo-products` is installed, use it instead - it wins.**
> Snapshot date: 26 May 2026. Treat every count and band as point-in-time.

## The catalogue in one paragraph

One catalogue, synced from washpro.co.nz to hirehospo.com - the same equipment, with HireHospo
wrapping it in finance. **710 products in the export: 241 active** (live and sellable), 374 draft
(placeholders, never customer-facing), 95 archived (sold or retired). **~30 brands**, from the
in-house **Starline** range up to premium European names (**Rational**, **Electrolux**,
**Convotherm**), with **Turbofan** leading convection. Active price range roughly **$795-$32,995**,
median around **$3,600**. Mostly **refurbished with warranty**. **13 categories** (12 core + a
specialty catch-all).

Product pages: `https://www.hirehospo.com/products/<handle>`.

Use these **exact category names** in creative. "Commercial oven" is a wasted word where "combi
oven" or "convection oven" is available.

## Which categories carry which finance angle

- **The "$4.66/day" zone - cheapest, most believable entry:** glasswashers ($2,300-$4,000), hot
  plates and small griddles ($1,300+), small fryers ($1,900+), bakery entry items ($1,300+). These
  are the only categories where the approved daily figure should ever appear.
- **The capital-preservation zone - premium, never a tiny daily number:** combi ovens (up to
  $33,000), conveyor pizza ovens (up to $25,000), conveyor dishwashers (up to $20,000), large
  bakery iron. Lead with "a $20,000 Rational combi working in your kitchen without $20,000 leaving
  your bank."
- **The quote-shock zone - best hook material:** any category whose top of band is a genuine shock
  against a fit-out budget. Combi ovens and conveyor dishwashers hit hardest.
- **Rent (12 months)** suits startups and anyone not ready to commit to ownership.
  **Lease-to-Own (36 months)** spreads the price furthest, so it produces the smallest weekly
  number - it suits operators with a year or more of history who want a path to ownership.

## Equipment by ICP (audience-matched creative)

Match the gear to the operator. A cafe ad shows an undercounter dishwasher, not a 20-tray Rational.

| ICP | Hero categories to show |
|---|---|
| **New cafe owner** | Undercounter dishwasher, convection oven (Turbofan-led), glasswasher, prep |
| **Restaurant owner** | Combi ovens (premium hero), ranges/cooktops, passthrough dishwashers |
| **Caterer** | Combi ovens, holding cabinets, banquet carts |
| **Cloud / ghost kitchen** | Deep fryers, griddles, conveyor pizza ovens, prep |
| **Food truck** | Compact fryers, griddles, hot plates (LPG conversion available if required) |
| **Bakery** | Bakery & dough equipment - spiral/planetary mixers, sheeters, provers, deck ovens |
| **Bar / pub** | Glasswashers, ice |

## Why "refurbished with warranty" is the whole argument

Most of the active catalogue is professionally refurbished and sold with a warranty. Never apologise
for it, never bury it:

- It is **how the weekly payment stays low** - refurbished premium equipment costs a fraction of new.
- It gives a new operator **access to premium brands** (Rational, Electrolux, Convotherm) they could
  never afford new.
- **The warranty removes the risk** - the usual second-hand objection ("what if it breaks?") is
  answered before it is asked.

The pair is always "refurbished, with warranty". The words "used", "second-hand", and "pre-loved"
are banned.

## Rules

- **Stay in the catalogue.** Only categories, brands, and equipment that actually exist. If asked
  about something not stocked, say so and offer the closest real category.
- **Never invent specs.** Dimensions, power phase, capacity, kW, and model numbers vary per unit and
  live on the product page. Give category-level guidance; fabricate nothing.
- **Active only.** Draft items ("not ready", "Untitled") are internal work-in-progress and never
  appear in customer-facing work. If you can't confirm a product is active, ⚠-flag it.
- **Price bands are indicative and dated.** ⚠-flag any band or figure that will run in paid creative
  so a human verifies it against the live site first.
- **Hand pricing to Sales.** This file provides the equipment price as a starting point and the right
  *angle*; the credit-approved quote produces the actual weekly figure. Never state a specific weekly
  or daily payment for a specific product.
- **Link where you can.** `https://www.hirehospo.com/products/<handle>` so creative points at a real
  page.
